title: Optimal Transport Flow Matching by Design
author: Shimon Malnick; Matan Rusanovsky; Ohad Fried; Shai Avidan
summary: This paper introduces a method that uses low-frequency image projections as a prior for flow matching, resulting in optimal transport couplings with straight, non-crossing trajectories. This approach improves generation quality and speed, enabling few-step or even single-step image synthesis with lower errors and better sample coherence. The method integrates well with existing models and consistently outperforms baselines on datasets like CIFAR-10 and FFHQ.
